mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1% triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening periods, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates and demand growth (GDPC1) creates a dual easing signal, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND GDPC1 increases over the past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rates below 6.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during low unemployment periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals sustained monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS) combined with weakening labor supply (UNRATE) creates a tight labor market, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases AND UNRATE decreases over the past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tight labor periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in both demand (GDPC1) and production (INDPRO) indices indicates robust economic growth, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases AND INDPRO increases over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during expansion periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate during a monetary tightening cycle raises borrowing costs, dampening corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases over the past month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening periods, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
